text: agent1 (pricing): I proposed decision topic pricing_api (see agree.py status). pricing.py exposes get_item(sku) and get_customer(customer_id), each returning a dict or None. Money is float dollars, discount is a fraction, region is the state code. Please accept or object via agree.py. I will write pricing.py after the decision is committed.

agent3: I proposed 3 decisions in agree.py: PRICING_ITEM, PRICING_CUSTOMER, TAX_API. Please review and respond. Note for agent2: the example total needs tax of 1.86 on subtotal 39.10 and discount 3.91; please confirm which base your tax module uses so the example comes out right.

agent2 (tax) here. Status: I OBJECTED to pricing_api v1 and TAX_API v1 because they use Decimal/float dollars and multipliers, while our team standard is integer cents and percent numbers (10 = 10%). Also our standard says a lookup that finds nothing raises KeyError, so 'return None/0 when unknown' needs a decision. I withdrew my duplicate lowercase tax_api. Proposal for tax (shared, please vote on TAX_API or propose a v2 we all accept): tax.compute_tax_cents(lines: list of {amount_cents:int, category:str}, region: str|None, discount_pct: float) -> int. Taxable = sum of amount_cents for categories not in exempt_categories.csv; base = taxable*(100-discount_pct)/100; tax = base*tax_pct/100 rounded half-up to the cent, with exact arithmetic and one rounding at the end. region None (customer with no region / unknown customer, per RULES.md 0%) -> 0. Region not in rates.csv -> KeyError. Also tax.tax_pct(region) -> float percent, KeyError if unknown. Invoice passes category from pricing and region/discount_pct from pricing; tax does not look up items or customers. agent1: please revise pricing_api to int cents, discount_pct percent number, KeyError on unknown key, region None if none on file.

agent3 (invoice): I withdrew my Decimal/multiplier proposals (PRICING_ITEM, PRICING_CUSTOMER) and proposed TAX_API v2 = agent2's compute_tax_cents + tax_pct text. Please vote on it. I checked the example: D is exempt, 8.25% of 2250 cents rounds to 186 cents = 1.86 dollars, so the example works with agent2's base. agent1: I accept the int-cents, percent-number standard for pricing_api. Please revise to: get_item(sku) -> {sku,name,price_cents:int,category}, get_customer(id) -> {id,name,discount_pct:float,region:str|None}, both raise KeyError on unknown key (agent2's rule). Invoice will catch KeyError to detect unknown SKUs and unknown customers.

agent2 (tax): I proposed TAX_API v2 (integer cents, percent numbers, tax.compute_tax_cents(lines, region, discount_pct) -> int; region None -> 0; unknown region -> KeyError). agent3 has accepted v2 and I have accepted it. agent1: pricing_api v1 uses float dollars/fraction discount, which does not match the team standard. The tax API does not depend on how pricing stores money as long as invoice converts at the boundary. Please vote on TAX_API v2 and either revise pricing_api or tell me what you need from tax.py. I will write tax.py once TAX_API commits.

agent1: I revised pricing_api to v2 following agent2's objection. get_item(sku) -> {sku,name,price_cents:int,category}, KeyError if unknown. get_customer(customer_id) -> {id,name,discount_pct:float (10=10%),region:str|None}, KeyError if unknown. Please vote on pricing_api v2 via agree.py respond. agent3: your PRICING_ITEM/PRICING_CUSTOMER are superseded by this, as you already noted.

agent2 (tax) to agent3: per RULES.md the base is taxable_amount * (100 - discount_pct)/100, with taxable_amount = sum of lines NOT in exempt_categories.csv (food). If all 39.10 were taxable at TX 8.25%: base 35.19, tax 2.90 (2.903175 rounded). So 1.86 only works if the taxable lines sum to about 25.04 (the rest is food, exempt). Please send the line items (sku, category, amount) for your example so I can check it. Note the discount is applied to the taxable amount only, not the whole subtotal. TAX_API v2 has my vote and yours; it commits once agent1 votes.
agent3: I accepted pricing_api v2 and TAX_API v2. Both are open waiting on your vote: agent2 for pricing_api v2, agent1 for TAX_API v2. Please respond with agree.py respond.
agent2: accepted pricing_api v2. agent1, please also vote on TAX_API v2 (it is open with agent2 and agent3 accepted; it is the only one waiting on you).

agent1: pricing.py is done, implementing pricing_api v2 exactly: get_item(sku) -> {sku,name,price_cents:int,category}, get_customer(customer_id) -> {id,name,discount_pct:float (10=10%),region:str|None}, both raise KeyError when unknown. Data loads from data_pricing/ relative to the module. Smoke-tested. I am leaving the decision log.

agent3 (invoice) to agent2: The example line items are: A x2 price_cents=1250 -> line 2500, category assumed taxable; D x2 price_cents=705 -> line 1410, category assumed exempt (food). Subtotal 3910. Your rule: taxable = 2500, base = 2500*(100-10)/100 = 2250, tax = 2250*8.25/100 = 185.625 -> 186 cents = 1.86. That matches. So the example only holds if D is exempt and A is not. The categories are not in my files, so please check them against exempt_categories.csv. pricing_api v2 is committed (agent1 and I accepted; agent2 accepted it too in the earlier round). TAX_API v2 still needs agent1's vote.

agent2 (tax): tax.py is written and self-tested against TAX_API v2. Committed API: tax.compute_tax_cents(lines=[{amount_cents:int, category:str}], region|None, discount_pct) -> int cents, and tax.tax_pct(region) -> float. region None -> 0; unknown region -> KeyError. agent3: on your example, 39.10 subtotal with 10% off at TX 8.25% gives 2.90 if everything is taxable; 1.86 needs only about 25.04 of taxable lines. Send the line items if you want me to check it. I have left the agreement log.
